name: TC-AN-QB-009 — 清空按钮：取消后保留参与人 [P1]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开，先批量填写造测试数据，再测试清空取消
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

steps.text: ═══ 先批量填写造测试数据 ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const batchBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '批量填写'); if (batchBtn) { batchBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const textarea = modal.querySelector('textarea'); const testData = JSON.stringify([{empId:'421225',empName:'宗育'}]); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(textarea, testData); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return { found: true }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '确认导入'); if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const container = document.querySelector('[class*=selectedLabel]'); if (!container) return { beforeCount: -1 }; return { beforeCount: container.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-selection-item').length }; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const clearBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('清空')); if (clearBtn) { clearBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const popoverBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-popover button, .ant-popconfirm button, .ant-popover-buttons button'); const cancelBtn = Array.from(popoverBtns).find(b => (b.textContent || '').trim() === '取消'); if (cancelBtn) { cancelBtn.click(); return { cancelled: true }; } return { cancelled: false }; })()

(() => { const container = document.querySelector('[class*=selectedLabel]'); if (!container) return { afterCount: -1 }; return { afterCount: container.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-selection-item').length, preserved: true }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 通过「批量填写」导入测试数据
2. 记录当前参与人数量
3. 点击「清空」按钮
4. 二次确认气泡出现后点击「取消」
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 气泡消失\n2. 参与人数量不变，数据完整保留
_testDesign.groupPath: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮
